description: Dated additions and removals from the S&P 500, sourced from Wikipedia's maintained "Historical components of the S&P 500" table (every S&P-announced swap since 1963, each with its effective date, the ticker/company added, the ticker/company removed, and the stated reason). Answers "what changed in the S&P 500 in 2024", "when was X removed from the S&P 500 and what replaced it". Only sp500 is covered — the iShares-backed indexes above have no equivalent public, dated changes table.

from.description: Earliest effective date to include, as a year ("2024") or ISO date ("2024-01-01"). Omit for no lower bound.

limit.description: Max rows to return, most recent first (default 50, max 600).

to.description: Latest effective date to include, as a year ("2024") or ISO date ("2024-12-31"). Omit for no upper bound.

name: constituent_changes
title: Constituent Changes
